items.headline: Armani and Kith take menswear to the desert
items.caption: Their third collab, Dreams of the Dune, runs from black and deep blue to sand and icy white.
body: Giorgio Armani and Kith showed the third chapter of their menswear collaboration at sunset on 9 October in the Agafay Desert, south of Marrakech.
The colours move from black and deep blue through dark brown and burnt earth to sand, greige and icy white.
The Fall/Winter 2026 line uses leather and cashmere, with shoes made with ASICS and Diemme.

items.headline: Store owner stops a runaway school bus with 18 kids aboard
items.caption: Ebro Ahmed, 27, climbed in after the driver had a seizure. Every child was safe.
body: In St. Paul, Minnesota, 27-year-old Ebro Ahmed saw a school bus roll past his store while the driver was having a seizure.
He climbed aboard, put the bus in neutral, set the parking brake and called for help. None of the 18 children were hurt, and the driver is expected to be OK.
He credits the TV show Grey's Anatomy for helping him stay calm, and he was given a $1,000 award.

items.headline: This week's sneakers: Saucony collab and bubblegum-pink Vans
items.caption: Highsnobiety's weekly picks include its own Saucony collaboration and a loud pink Vans.
body: Highsnobiety's roundup of the best sneakers for the third week of October includes a Highsnobiety x Saucony collaboration.
A bubblegum-pink Vans also makes the list, alongside picks from New Balance and others.
Its drop calendar shows more releases through late October, including Salomon x Maison Margiela.

items.headline: Amazon deforestation falls to its lowest in almost 40 years
items.caption: Clearing in Brazil's Amazon is down nearly 42% from the same period last year.
body: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon has fallen to its lowest level in almost four decades, according to the latest data.
That is a drop of nearly 42% compared with the same period last year.

items.headline: Brown tailoring is this autumn's power move
items.caption: Esquire UK's latest issue backs brown suits and Armani's soft-shouldered greige coat.
body: Esquire UK's September/October issue makes the case for brown tailoring this season.
It also highlights Armani's soft-shouldered, ankle-length coat cut in washed greige wool.
Autumn guides point the same way, toward warm browns, heritage checks and soft knitwear.

items.headline: Women in Nigeria plant 150,000 mangroves to heal their coast
items.caption: Women-led groups are replanting mangroves in a polluted part of the country.
body: In a polluted region of Nigeria, women-led groups are replanting mangrove forests.
One trainee and a dozen other women have planted more than 150,000 mangrove saplings.
